item.title: Testing beyond your imagination: Property-based testing in C# with FsCheck
item.description: Property-based testing is a powerful alternative to example-based testing. Instead of defining specific inputs and verifying their outcomes, you define properties that should always hold true. Let’s learn how to use FsCheck to write property-based tests in C# with NUnit. Link to article: https://www.code4it.dev/blog/property-based-testing-fscheck/
